definitions.explanation: moving up (a schedule, date, or deadline); advancing (to an earlier time)
carrying (in arithmetic, when a digit exceeds 9)

examples.japanese: ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧お{願|ねが}いします。
⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧1⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}げになった。
examples.english: The meeting was moved up by one hour.

examples.japanese: ⟦{卒業式|そつぎょうしき}→卒業式：05584_sotsugyoushiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}げ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The advancement of the graduation ceremony date was announced.

examples.japanese: ⟦{足|た}し{算|ざん}→足し算：05332_tashizan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}げ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧。
{繰|く}り{上|あ}げ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}→計算：02697_keisan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧だ。
examples.english: I'm not good at carrying calculations.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二桁|ふたけた}→二桁：15881_futaketa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}げ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
examples.english: Carrying with two-digit numbers is difficult.

notes:
{繰|く}り{上|あ}げ is a noun derived from the verb {繰|く}り{上|あ}げる (to move up, to advance). The word has two main uses: scheduling and arithmetic.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}げ (schedule advancement)
- ⟦{日程|にってい}→日程：04289_nittei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{繰|く}り{上|あ}げ (moving up the date)
- {繰|く}り{上|あ}げ⟦{当選|とうせん}→当選：07074_tousen⟧ (winning by advancement, e.g., when a higher-ranked candidate withdraws)

FORMS:
- {繰|く}り{上|あ}げる (to move up, to advance)
- {繰|く}り{上|あ}がる (to be moved up - intransitive)

REGISTER: Neutral. Used in business, academic, and everyday contexts.
